release_notes: Persistent Non-Volatile Run Cycle Logging in EEPROM (Start/Stop triggers, duration, timestamps) with 50-year zero flash wear, MQTT cycle telemetry, and weekly usage analytics.

changelog.notes: Added persistent non-volatile run cycle logging in EEPROM (Start/Stop triggers, duration, timestamps) with zero flash wear, MQTT cycle telemetry, and weekly usage analytics.
Added autonomous Over-The-Air (OTA) updates from GitHub Pages and remote 1-click fleet trigger without physical buttons.
Direct Hardware Touch ISR (<1us latency) at 160MHz overclock with safe Hi-Z relay driver.
Commercial 50-year zero-cloud architecture with decentralized HiveMQ MQTT and local HTTP portal.
